# The one maintained list of Windows-sensitive paths for CI.
#
# Any changed path that matches a pattern below starts the Windows lane
# immediately in .github/workflows/ci.yml.
#
# Files whose old or new content contains a Windows cfg gate (`windows` in a
# `cfg`, `cfg!`, or `cfg_attr` predicate, `target_os = "windows"`,
# `target_family = "windows"`, `target_env = "msvc"`, or `not(unix)`) are
# matched automatically by scripts/ci-platform-paths.sh. So list here the
# paths whose Windows behavior that scan cannot see: modules that wrap Windows
# behavior without naming it, dependencies, and build and CI inputs.
#
# When you add a new Windows-specific module or wrapper, add its path in the
# same change.
#
# Everything else is covered by the nightly run in
# .github/workflows/nightly.yml. Blank lines and `#` lines are ignored.

# CI definitions for the Windows lane and for this filter.
.github/workflows/*
.github/actions/*
.github/windows-ci-paths.txt
scripts/ci-platform-paths.sh
scripts/test-ci-platform-paths.sh

# Toolchain, dependencies, lint config, and build scripts.
Cargo.toml
*/Cargo.toml
Cargo.lock
rust-toolchain*
.cargo/*
clippy.toml
build.rs
*/build.rs

# Native desktop app, built on WebView2 on Windows.
mj-desktop/*

# PowerShell installer and its test.
install.ps1
scripts/install-ps1.test.mjs

# ConPTY dashboard smoke.
mj-cli/tests/terminal_windows.rs
